name: t3-welcome-glass
notes: t3-welcome (tester run 2 item C): the greeting when nothing waits, KidsAtGlass. Three kids by the fire hear the Keeper is back, hurry to the front glass (Walk 3 s; the planner caps the walk at 3.5 s), wave (Wave), then press their hands to it (PressHands) as the end beat. Facing 0 = toward the camera and the glass (checked on a zoomed sheet: face and headband show; the arm goes up for the wave, both hands out for the press). The cuts are staggered (0.55 + 0.06 per kid of the greeting) so neighbours never move in step. Game: LifePlanner.StageGreeting(KidsAtGlass), Wave then PressHands at the glass place, faces the glass. 10 s in all. The planner's walks follow the paths here straight.
